hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: The data is compressed where order_occurrences indicates the frequency of item_count.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Total items purchased is sum(item_count * order_occurrences).

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: Divide by total orders sum(order_occurrences) and round to 2 decimal places.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(item_count * order_occurrences) / SUM(order_occurrences), 2) AS average_items_per_order
FROM Orders;
```

variables: N: total records in primary table
